correctness.rationale: Every automorphism preserves component degree and hence stabilizes the six-line set. Dual line vectors yield exactly four collinear triples arranged as the K4 incidence structure. Four-point-frame reconstruction enumerates 72 frames and 24 exact projectivities inducing the full S4 on the four concurrency classes; this is exhaustive over C because any projectivity is determined uniquely by one projective frame and its image, even with rational representative coordinates. Six published conic quadratic forms transported as B Q B^T (B=A^(-T)) cut the 24 maps to exactly six. A wholly independent SymPy rational-matrix reconstruction reproduced all 72 frames, 24 line stabilizers and 6 conic-preserving projectivities, matching the supplied verifier. Direct matrix multiplication checks that listed s,t generate six transformations with s^2=t^3=(st)^2=1 in PGL3. Applying the six maps to added line covectors yields the 3 free-line and 6 plus-one-line orbits. Projectivity preserves the free/plus-one properties and exponent data, subject to originally published examples.
residual_risks: Source property of added line free/plus-one must be taken from verified primary Example2.8; symmetry transfers only those source lines, not all possible additions.
